lanes.title: Requirement-to-evidence closure
lanes.mechanism: Require every registered lead to name its implementation target, deterministic falsifier, measurement gate, status, and evidence path.
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: Reject a registry with a missing or duplicate R00-R99 identifier or an empty required field.
lanes.measurement_gate: Not a speed claim; the final campaign validator must bind every promoted row to one registered lead.

lanes.title: Source revision binding
lanes.mechanism: Fail closed unless the instance record identifies the frozen composed source revision.
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: Change source_revision away from d85752a9a0; the native validator must exit nonzero.
lanes.measurement_gate: Every measured record must bind the pushed commit, source digest, binary digest, and immutable protocol digest.

lanes.title: Reproducible binary and digest capsule
lanes.mechanism: Compile the same frozen source twice with the same revision binding and require byte-identical binaries.
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: A byte difference or digest mismatch between the two builds rejects the capsule.
lanes.measurement_gate: The isolated runner must rebuild or fetch the exact digest-pinned binary and record the compiler and host capsule.

lanes.title: Known-answer algebra self-test
lanes.mechanism: Exercise reciprocal reduction, partition selection, direct inversion, batch inversion, simultaneous multiplication, setup, and planted logs before candidate admission.
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: Any field mismatch, point mismatch, planted-log failure, or self-test panic rejects the build.
lanes.measurement_gate: The exact self-test runs inside the measured image before and after the timed panel.

lanes.title: Counted versus production differential pairing
lanes.mechanism: Pair strong-bW and fast-bW arms and require identical mathematical and native execution fields at W in {1,4,8,16,32}.
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: A one-step mutation in fast-b8 must be rejected; the prototype self-test performs this mutation in memory.
lanes.measurement_gate: Every candidate width needs paired counted and production records on identical instances.

lanes.title: Counter authority fail-closed gate
lanes.mechanism: Counted arms alone may claim count authority; production arms must report false authority and zero field counters.
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: Set fast-b4 count_authoritative=true or fast-b1 walk.fq_mul=1; both mutations must be rejected.
lanes.measurement_gate: Modeled-cost analysis must reject null, false, malformed, and zero-filled authority substitutions.

lanes.title: Full trajectory invariant tuple
lanes.mechanism: Bind batch, setup mode, instance, recovered scalar, steps, distinguished points, retries, cycles, and native transition counts across paired modes.
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: Any paired-field mismatch, including one changed step, is a hard failure.
lanes.measurement_gate: Candidate and control records must retain the complete tuple rather than compare only the final scalar.

lanes.title: Collision-scalar recovery gate
lanes.mechanism: Require ok=true and k_found=k for every retained rho record.
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: A wrong recovered scalar or false success value rejects the complete input.
lanes.measurement_gate: Every measured target must be a public known-answer fixture or carry an independently verified group equation.

lanes.title: Phase-complete accounting
lanes.mechanism: Retain setup, walk, and verification counters separately and reject a comparison that omits any phase.
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: A missing phase counter or nonnumeric counter makes the native control parser fail.
lanes.measurement_gate: Cold one-target comparisons include setup, online walk, collision solve, and answer verification.

lanes.title: Exact composed count vector
lanes.mechanism: Bind the complete strong-b8 phase vector to the reviewed composed record rather than recompute a sum of standalone lane deltas.
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: Changing any of the 24 strong-b8 phase counters rejects the record.
lanes.measurement_gate: A newly composed binary establishes a new exact vector before any wall experiment.

lanes.title: RNG and retry-order invariance
lanes.mechanism: Include setup RNG, scalar-add, lookahead, retry, cycle, and table diagnostics in differential equality.
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: A candidate that rolls back or reorders RNG/retry state changes one bound execution field and is rejected.
lanes.measurement_gate: Setup-reuse candidates must preserve sequential sampling and charge failed infinity retries.

lanes.title: Arm parser fail-closed behavior
lanes.mechanism: Reject unknown suffixes, zero widths, and malformed batch widths rather than silently selecting another arm.
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: Run strong-b8junk; acceptance or exit zero fails the lead.
lanes.measurement_gate: The frozen arm manifest and emitted arm field must match exactly in every session.

lanes.title: Rejected-variant retention
lanes.mechanism: Keep incorrect setup rollback and count-negative retry-compaction evidence while excluding their code from the composed source.
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: A composition that imports a rejected source or deletes its recorded failure is rejected in review.
lanes.measurement_gate: Every attempted variant remains addressable by source/evidence digest and explicit disposition.

lanes.title: Optimized-IR counter-elision
lanes.mechanism: Inspect optimized LLVM IR and require zero counter SSA read/modify/write markers in COUNT=false arithmetic and walk wrappers.
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: Any counter SSA marker in the production specialization fails the gate.
lanes.measurement_gate: Repeat with the exact compiler used by the isolated binary and retain the optimized IR digest.

lanes.title: Release-build reproducibility
lanes.mechanism: Require two clean invocations of rustc with the same revision binding to produce identical bytes.
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: cmp or SHA-256 disagreement rejects the build.
lanes.measurement_gate: The measured image binds this digest and preserves the build command and compiler version.

lanes.title: Nonadditive composition gate
lanes.mechanism: Re-run one composed binary after accepted mutations; never infer its total from isolated candidate deltas.
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: Missing composed raw output, a trajectory change, or a mismatch with the exact count vector blocks promotion.
lanes.measurement_gate: Only the final composed binary may become the next baseline in the matched grid.

lanes.title: Independent replay and signed standing
lanes.mechanism: Hand the immutable raw records to a separately authored replay/validator and require the repository validation and PCC chains before publication.
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: A replay mismatch, missing signature, producer-authored independence assertion, or nonverified standing blocks the claim.
lanes.measurement_gate: VALIDATION.json must point to replay, validator, and matched-rho artifacts; pcc standing must be signed by an accepted verifier.
